schoolId: Nullable provider school identifier. Missing IDs are preserved.
approved: Approval at the source snapshot date.
featureType: Provider category for a mapped plan point.
sourceRetrievedAt: UTC retrieval time of the geometry source.
evidence: Geometry source URL; the manifest identifies the checksummed receipt.
schoolApprovalEvidenceUrl: Optional independent evidence of school plan approval.
id: GeoJSON feature ID, UDOT layer plus GlobalID or its layer object ID.
campusStatus: planned identifies geometry intended for a future campus.
campusAddress: Address served by the planned routes.
currentCampusAddress: Operating school address at the time of review. These routes do not give directions there.
campusEvidence: Source that connects the plan address to the future campus.

bicycleStress.id: Feature ID deterministic within a release. Join via routeId and schoolId to the original route.
bicycleStress.part: Zero-based LineString part in the parent geometry.
bicycleStress.routeId: Original full UDOT route feature ID.
bicycleStress.stress: lower, higher or unassessed; highest assessed direction.
bicycleStress.lengthMeters: Length of this segment in projected meters.
bicycleStress.forward: Native score along route-coordinate order, null if unknown or unavailable.
bicycleStress.reverse: Native score in reverse route-coordinate order, null if unknown or unavailable.
bicycleStress.forwardBearing: Approximate compass heading in forward travel.
bicycleStress.reverseBearing: Approximate compass heading in reverse travel.
bicycleStress.source: Local Brokenspoke, Utah Bikeways, UDOT plan crosswalk, or null.
bicycleStress.sourceDate: OSM replication date, Utah edit date or plan point retrieval date.
bicycleStress.street: Source name of the traveled street, when known.
bicycleStress.crossStreet: Other named arms of this node, when known.
bicycleStress.matchStatus: matched, ambiguous, unmatched, connected-through or plan-crosswalk.
bicycleStress.directionBasis: route-coordinate-order for BNA, undirected for Utah.
bicycleStress.approachIds: BNA roads used for forward and reverse approaches.
bicycleStress.coverage: Lengths include repeated plan geometry. comparedMeters and disagreeMeters compare BNA and Utah on dual-matched portions.
bicycleStress.ridingCondition: Calmer and Busier follow the PeopleForBikes movement model. Utah fallback scores are calibrated against local BNA ratings by facility and native score. Unvalidated Utah strata retain the native band (0–1 Calmer, 2 Moderate, 3–4 Busier). Not rated means no defensible rating. See the calibration table and held-out errors in sources.json. Native values and the historic stress field remain available.
bicycleStress.conditionBasis: bna, calibrated-facility, bracketed-same-way, native-utah or not-rated; identifies the basis of the displayed condition.
bicycleStress.anchorBnaRoad: BNA road anchoring a short fallback between consistent same-way transitions.
bicycleStress.utahFacility: Publisher facility used to select the Utah calibration stratum.
